Defining determinants (data-driven signa: Highest child undernutrition (stunting, wasting, underweight); lowest maternal education (2.5 years) and facility delivery (10%). Determinants span nutrition, maternal health, education and service delivery.
States (LGAs): Kano (36); Jigawa (27); Katsina (17); Bauchi (13); Kebbi (13); Yobe (12); Gombe (6); Sokoto (6); Kaduna (5); Niger (1)
Targeted lever / intervention: Reaching-Every-Community microplanning; Basic Health Care Provision Fund (BHCPF) funded outreach; seasonal scheduling to farming cycles; community-based health worker deployment; co-deliver with nutrition and antenatal contacts and female-education demand linkages.
Evidence base and allocation rationale (: Binding constraints: geographic access, low female education, weak maternal-and-child-health platform. Fixed-plus-outreach delivery integrated with nutrition and antenatal contacts is the evidence-based response. Frameworks: WHO Reaching Every District / Reaching Every Community (RED/REC); WHO, UNICEF and Gavi 'The Big Catch-Up' (2023); Gavi zero-dose IRMMA framework (Identify, Reach, Monitor and Measure, Advocate).

Targeted lever / intervention: Security-integrated microplanning; negotiated humanitarian access; permanent transit-point and mobile vaccination for mobile and nomadic groups; cross-local-government population tracking; traditional-birth-attendant demand outreach.
Evidence base and allocation rationale (: Binding constraint: insecurity and population mobility. Negotiated-access campaigns, permanent transit-point and mobile vaccination, and security-integrated microplanning are the established responses. Frameworks: WHO/UNICEF immunization in humanitarian and conflict settings; polio-programme negotiated access and 'Days of Tranquility'; WHO permanent-transit-point strategy for nomadic and cross-border populations.

Defining determinants (data-driven signa: Extreme travel time to care (about 108 minutes); low improved-water access. Determinants span geographic access and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH).
States (LGAs): Cross River (6); Bayelsa (4); Delta (4); Rivers (3); Taraba (2); Adamawa (1)
Targeted lever / intervention: Boat-based and mobile outreach; community health worker networks; multi-antigen bundling to maximise each visit; integrate with WASH and maternal-health services.
Evidence base and allocation rationale (: Binding constraint: extreme physical access. Transport-adapted (boat) outreach with multi-antigen bundling maximises each costly contact. Frameworks: WHO RED/REC integrated-outreach strategy for hard-to-reach populations; documented riverine and boat-clinic service-delivery models.
